item.title: WRE News: Trump Considers Executive Order to Reclassify Marijuana
item.description: Miami, FL - December 13, 2025 - Donald Trump is weighing a move that could reshape federal marijuana policy without fully legalizing the drug. According to reports, Trump is considering an executive order that would direct federal agencies to reclassify marijuana as a less dangerous substance than its current Schedule I status, which groups it alongside drugs like heroin and LSD.
